t: How to send prayers upon him, in full
a: قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ
p: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasūlik, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, wa bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa āli Ibrāhīm.
m: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad, Your servant and Messenger, as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrāhīm. And send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm.
